title: incident-bot: enhance SLO toolkit runbook linking and on-call helpers
author: Jordan Patel
description: Context: on-call runbook lookup and SLO toolkit helpers currently return noisy/irrelevant suggestions during incidents which slows responders. This PR improves runbook linking relevance, surface-level metadata, and adds lightweight on-call helper utilities for quick diagnostics. Motivation: reduce mean time to mitigation by surfacing higher-precision runbooks and curated diagnostic commands; enable SLO toolkit to attach runbook links directly to SLO alerts. Changes include a new runbook-ranking heuristic that combines SLO tags, recent incident similarity, and service ownership; a compact runbook preview payload for chat/UIs; helper commands for on-call responders to fetch topology and recent error rates; and unit+integration tests. Checklist: [x] implement heuristic; [x] add linking utility into slo-toolkit; [x] add on-call helpers and CLI bindings; [x] add tests; [x] update docs; [x] get approvals and CI green. Impact: backwards-compatible API additions, improved suggestion precision, minor added CPU cost for link scoring (configurable).
commit_summary: 4 commits: initial ranking prototype; integrate ranking into runbook linker; add on-call helper CLI and tests; docs and cleanup.

Nadia Singh: CLI ergonomics nit: make fetch --since default to 1h, not 30m; Author reply: updated CLI flag default and added backward-compatible handling in helpers.

release_notes: - Improve runbook linking relevance and add team-configurable weights; - Expose compact runbook preview payload for UIs; - Add on-call helper commands to fetch topology and recent SLO error rates; - Add metrics to observe runbook scoring decisions.
